title: Infused Wheat
description: Enhance your Minecraft experience with Infused Wheat—a mod that introduces new recipes and food items to the game.
body:
### 🌾 Infused Wheat

## 🛠️ Features
- New Crafting Recipes: Transform regular wheat into dried wheat through smelting, and combine dried wheat with iron or diamond to create iron-infused and diamond-infused Wheat, respectively.
  
- Unique Food Items: Each infused bread variant offers distinct benefits, adding variety and strategy to your food choices.
  
- Advancements System: Unlock achievements by crafting and using the new infused bread items, encouraging exploration of the mod's features.
  
- Custom Creative Tab: All items are neatly organized under a dedicated tab in the creative inventory for easy access.

## 📦 Items Included
- Dried Wheat: Smelt regular wheat to obtain dried wheat.
  
- Iron Infused Dried Wheat: Combine dried wheat with iron to create iron-infused dried wheat.
  
- Diamond Infused Dried Wheat: Combine dried wheat with diamond to create diamond-infused dried wheat.
  
- Iron Infused Bread: Craft using iron-infused dried wheat to obtain iron-infused bread.
  
- Diamond Infused Bread: Craft using diamond-infused dried wheat to obtain diamond-infused bread.
  
## 🧪 Advancements
- Drying Out: Unlock this advancement by obtaining dried wheat.
  
- Iron Infusion: Unlock this advancement by crafting iron-infused bread.
  
- Diamond Delight: Unlock this advancement by crafting diamond-infused bread.

## 🎨 Creative Tab
 - All items are accessible under the "Infused Wheat" tab in the creative inventory, providing a streamlined experience for players.
